verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say each review finding explains how to fix the issue, and that users can 'let Qodo apply the fix directly' or use 'Fix with Chat Agent' to remediate from the PR chat. That is the product's own fix-application capability in PR review. However, the evidence never shows the fix rendered as a committable suggested diff in the review comment, or a one-click commit/apply button. missing for 10: explicit committable suggestion diffs in PR comments, documented one-click apply/commit mechanics per Git provider, independent or hands-on corroboration.
